title: Audit trail
description: Every recorded change: who did what, when, and what it changed. Entries cannot be edited or deleted.

locked.title: The audit trail is for administrators
locked.body: The audit trail records what every member did, so only administrators can read it. You can see the recent changes to units on the dashboard.

chain.heading: Audit chain integrity
chain.description: Each entry stores a fingerprint of the entry before it. Verifying recomputes every fingerprint to prove that nothing was altered or removed from the middle of the history.
chain.notRunBody: Verification reads the whole trail, so it runs only when you ask.
chain.intactBody: {entries, plural, one {The # entry links} other {All # entries link}} to its predecessor and matches its recorded fingerprint. Verified {when}.
chain.emptyBody: The audit trail is empty. Verified {when}.
chain.brokenBody: The first problem is at entry {seq}, out of {entries, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}}. Verified {when}.

kinds.sequenceGap: An entry is missing or out of order.
kinds.linkBroken: An earlier entry was altered or removed, so this entry no longer links to it.
kinds.contentAltered: This entry’s content no longer matches its fingerprint: it was altered.

chain.brokenAction: Do not edit the trail. Preserve the database as it is and report this to your quality lead and system administrator.
chain.tailNote: Verification cannot detect entries removed from the very end of the trail; that needs the latest fingerprint to be kept outside the database.
chain.adminOnly: Audit chain verification is available to administrators.

filters.label: Filter the audit trail
filters.searchPlaceholder: Summary, record, person, reason, request or entry number
filters.zoneNote: Dates are calendar days in the laboratory time zone.
filters.invalidDates: A date was not valid and was ignored. Use the date picker or the format YYYY-MM-DD.

list.count: {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}} matching the current filters
list.caption: Audit trail entries
list.emptyBody: Entries are written automatically each time someone changes a record.
list.noMatchBody: Widen the date range, or clear the filters to see everything.
